chunks: And that which was narrated - Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"And the Umrah is once every year."
ai.seo_question: How often should a Muslim perform Umrah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of Musa ibn al-Qasim in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the recommendation (mustahabb) of performing Umrah annually, distinguishing it from the obligatory Hajj. This ruling is situated within the chapter on expiations (kaffarat), highlighting how the spiritual merit of Umrah serves as a means of purification and atonement for minor ritual errors or omissions during the state of Ihram.
